Mumbai local train murder: Police recover weapon after viral video

Mumbai police have recovered the knife allegedly used in a fatal stabbing on a local train. The investigation was aided by a viral video of the incident, which helped authorities identify and locate the weapon. The accused, a restaurant worker, reportedly claimed to have carried the knife for months and discarded it after the stabbing.
